{{Short description|German physicist}}
'''Leo Stodolsky''' is an American physicist. He is the former director of the [[Max Planck Institute for Physics]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ias.edu/people/cos/users/1845|title=Stodolsky, Leo &#124; Institute for Advanced Study|publisher=Ias.edu|accessdate=2015-11-29}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|author=Erik Plauschinn|url=http://wwwth.mpp.mpg.de/members/les/|title=Leo Stodolsky|publisher=H.mpp.mpg.de|date=2006-02-28|accessdate=2015-11-29}}</ref>
